details: The agent faithfully executed both Task1 and Task2 as specified in analysis_info.json using the original dataset. Task1 produced t-test, chi-squared, logistic, Poisson, zero-inflated Poisson, and negative binomial results, including marginal effects at means where planned, and saved outputs to data/task1_results.json. Task2 ran the specified t-test and simple negative binomial model with only first_A, saving outputs to data/task2_results.json. A bounded code repair was applied to ZeroInflatedPoisson margins prediction (aligning exog/exog_infl) without altering the analysis design or dataset. No major deviations were observed; key planned metrics (e.g., NB z and p for first_A, t-test, chi-squared) were reported.
